about_section_title: Rehabilitation Center for Elderly and Disabled Persons „Hope” from Vadul lui Vodă city
about_text_1:
The Republican Center „Hope” constitutes an integral part of the national health protection system, an important link in curative and prophylactic measures regarding morbidity reduction, work capacity restoration and citizen health strengthening.
The „Hope” Center is located in Vadul lui Vodă town on the bank of the Nistru river in the Forest Park, 20 km from Chișinău city. The legal address of the „Hope” Center is Vadul lui Vodă city, Balneara street no. 11
The Center is a budgetary, curative-prophylactic and recovery institution, specialized, within the Ministry of Labor and Social Protection of the Republic of Moldova.
about_text_2:
The mission of the Rehabilitation Center for elderly people and people with disabilities (adults) is to offer integrated treatment and recovery services for people with cardiovascular conditions, in a modern framework adapted to each person's needs.
By combining balneo-climatic treatments and physical therapy, we offer a safe and comforting environment to support the recovery process, improving cardiovascular function, reducing complication risks and promoting superior quality of life.
Within the center, patients benefit from a varied range of therapies, including electrotherapy, balneotherapy, fangotherapy, thermotherapy, halotherapy, manual massage, dry carbonated baths, aeroiontherapy and oral oxygen therapy. These treatments are applied under careful supervision of a multidisciplinary medical team, formed by cardiologists, internists, neurologists, and rehabilitologists, who collaborate to offer a personalized approach to each case.
We dedicate ourselves to promoting a holistic rehabilitation process, which not only targets physical recovery, but also patient education for cardiovascular condition prevention, lifestyle improvement and functional autonomy consolidation. Our mission is to offer the highest quality care, to support patients in their complete recovery and their reintegration into daily activities, thus contributing to an active and healthy life.

faq_what_is_CRPVPD_q: What is the Rehabilitation Center for Elderly and Disabled Persons „Hope”?
faq_what_is_CRPVPD_a: The Rehabilitation Center for Elderly and Disabled Persons „Hope” from Vadul lui Vodă city is a public social assistance institution that offers specialized services for young children (0-7 years) in risk situations or with special needs. The center operates under the subordination of the Agency for Social Services and Inclusion and has the mission of protecting, caring for and rehabilitating vulnerable children.
faq_what_services_q: What services does the center offer?
faq_what_services_a: The center offers multiple specialized services: Crisis and Family Reintegration Section for children in emergency situations, Maternal Section for mothers and children in difficulty, Day Section for children with neuro-motor disabilities, Respite Section for families with children with special needs, Psycho-pedagogical Assistance Section, Rehabilitation Section and Medical Assistance Section.
faq_how_to_apply_q: How can I request the center's services?
faq_how_to_apply_a: To request the center's services, you must address the Child Protection Directorate in Vadul lui Vodă city or local guardianship and curatorship authorities. They will evaluate the situation and issue, if appropriate, a placement order. You can also contact the center directly at phone number 022 737 027 for consultations.
faq_emergency_contact_q: What number can I call in case of emergency?
faq_emergency_contact_a: In case of emergency, you can call phone number 022 737 027, which operates 24/7. The center has a non-stop operation regime for crisis situations. You can also contact the Child Protection Emergency Service or competent local authorities.
